issues.description: Milkable.messageOnMilk() has conflicting return types across artifacts. The UML in the problem statement declares messageOnMilk(): boolean and the text says it should return true/false based on milking success, but the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() as returning String and Goat/Seal implement it by returning a message String. This makes the required interface contract unclear and would cause student implementations to fail against whichever expectation the tests follow.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one contract and align UML/spec, template examples, and solution. If the intended behavior is a success flag, change Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return boolean and update Goat/Seal and the Main example accordingly. If the intended behavior is to return a message String, update the UML line and the Part 2 bullet to specify String (remove the true/false requirement).
